# HeroBot Chatbot Marketing — manage marketing chatbots via the Membrane CLI (short listing)

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the discovery manifest carries no verifiable license for this skill — the manifest makes faith, so no content is reproduced): @membranedev's herobot-chatbot-marketing skill (by the Membrane team), an integration skill for working with HeroBot chatbot marketing data. HeroBot is a chatbot platform aimed at small and medium businesses for automating marketing and sales conversations on websites and social channels — lead generation, customer engagement, support. The skill teaches the agent to use the Membrane CLI: install the CLI, log in via the browser authorization flow (headless supported), connect to HeroBot with `membrane connection ensure`, then manage the object model — Chatbots (content, messages, settings, analytics), Campaigns (leads, performance), Integrations (platforms), Users (profiles, subscriptions) — with connection state polling and JSON output.
